parts.label: a
parts.technique: Binomial cumulative probability
parts.reason: S4.1 covers calculating probabilities using the binomial distribution; this is a direct cdf calculation with no excluded elements.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Binomial cumulative probability
parts.reason: Same as (a): binomial probability calculation, fully covered by S4.1.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Binomial probability from a linear transformation of a binomial random variable
parts.reason: The scenario forms a linear combination of points but the actual mark-scheme method reduces this to a simple binomial probability calculation (P(F>10) using the binomial cdf). This is just a binomial probability calculation, not calculation of mean/variance of a discrete rv, so it is covered by S4.1.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Hypothesis test for a binomial proportion using Normal approximation with continuity correction
parts.reason: S5.2 covers hypothesis testing for a binomial proportion p, and S4.2 covers the Normal approximation to the binomial including continuity correction; both explicitly permitted.

parts.label: i(a)
parts.technique: Continuous uniform distribution probability
parts.reason: No statement in the specification mentions the continuous uniform distribution; S3.1 only references discrete/continuous distributions generally without defining U[a,b]. This named distribution is not covered, making it OUT.

parts.label: i(b)
parts.technique: Continuous uniform distribution probability calculation
parts.reason: Same uniform distribution issue as (i)(a); not a distribution named/covered in the specification statements.

parts.label: ii(a)
parts.technique: Stating a continuous uniform distribution
parts.reason: Requires stating S~U[0,22.5], again the uniform distribution, not covered by any statement.

parts.label: ii(b)
parts.technique: Continuous uniform distribution probability
parts.reason: Uses the uniform distribution from (ii)(a); not covered.

parts.label: ii(c)
parts.technique: Binomial probability using a probability derived from a uniform distribution
parts.reason: Although binomial itself is covered by S4.1, this part relies entirely on the probability found in the out-of-spec uniform-distribution part (ii)(b); per the rule a part that only makes sense after an out-of-spec part is OUT.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Cumulative distribution function manipulation of a continuous random variable
parts.reason: S4.2 explicitly states knowledge of the probability density function is not required, and this question works entirely with the cdf/pdf structure of a general continuous rv, a topic not otherwise introduced in the specification (no general continuous rv cdf/pdf statement exists).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Finding constant in cdf of continuous rv
parts.reason: Same as (a): requires working with cdf of a general continuous random variable, not covered.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Probability from cdf of continuous rv
parts.reason: Uses the cdf F(x) of a general continuous rv, not covered by any statement.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Sketching pdf and finding mode via differentiation of pdf
parts.reason: Requires deriving and sketching the pdf of a continuous rv; S4.2 explicitly excludes knowledge of the pdf, and no other statement covers this.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Poisson probability calculation
parts.reason: Poisson distribution is not mentioned anywhere in the specification statements; the exclusion list example explicitly names Poisson as an out-of-spec concept.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Poisson probability calculation
parts.reason: Same Poisson distribution issue as (a).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Poisson probability calculation
parts.reason: Same Poisson distribution issue.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Exponential distribution (time between Poisson events)
parts.reason: Relies on Poisson process / exponential distribution, neither of which is mentioned in the specification.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Conditional probability with Poisson/Binomial thinning
parts.reason: Based entirely on the Poisson distribution, not covered by any statement.

parts.label: f
parts.technique: Hypothesis test critical region using Poisson distribution
parts.reason: Poisson-based hypothesis test; Poisson is not a named distribution in the specification (S5.1-S5.3 only cover binomial proportion and Normal mean tests).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Sampling distribution probability calculation
parts.reason: This question constructs the sampling distribution of a derived score from two draws; 'sampling distribution' of a statistic (beyond simple random sampling in S1.1) is explicitly listed as an out-of-spec named concept.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Deriving a full sampling distribution table
parts.reason: Same sampling-distribution issue as (a); not covered by any statement.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Expected value of a discrete random variable (sampling distribution)
parts.reason: This is E(X) of a general discrete random variable derived from a sampling distribution, both of which are excluded (S4.1 excludes calculation of mean/variance of discrete rv; sampling distribution itself is out).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Sketching a piecewise probability density function
parts.reason: S4.2 explicitly excludes knowledge of the probability density function; this part requires sketching a given pdf of a continuous rv, not covered elsewhere.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Variance of a continuous random variable using E(Y^2)
parts.reason: Requires variance of a continuous rv defined via its pdf, which is excluded (S4.2 pdf knowledge not required; no statement covers moments of general continuous rv).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Deriving cdf by integrating pdf
parts.reason: Direct integration of a pdf to obtain cdf of a general continuous rv is not covered; S4.2 excludes pdf knowledge and derivation of cdf.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Full cdf derivation over piecewise pdf
parts.reason: Same as (c), extended; not covered by the specification.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Percentile of a continuous distribution via cdf
parts.reason: Requires solving cdf equation for a general continuous rv, not covered.

parts.label: f
parts.technique: Conditional probability using cdf of continuous rv
parts.reason: Uses cdf-based conditional probability of a general continuous rv, not covered.
